subject: Draft MAP + 30-day evaluation checklist for Lumina Labs
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Ravi Singh <ravi.singh@luminalabs.com>, Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@luminalabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP + 30-day evaluation checklist for Lumina Labs

Hi Ravi / Sara —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Per our call, I pulled together a short mutual action plan and a companion 30-day evaluation checklist to help structure the trial and acceptance criteria. The goal of this MAP is to align owners, measurable success signals, and a tight cadence so we can validate performance on a small slice of your production workload within 30 days.

What's included (high level):
- Week-by-week milestones (data access, sandbox tests, latency targets)
- Clear owners for infra/engineering/PM tasks
- Acceptance criteria for pilot (sample throughput, quality regression thresholds)
- Rollout guardrails and fallback routes if we hit capacity or SLO misses

Please review the prototype doc (linked below) and the checklist. Two asks:
1) Can you confirm the primary stakeholders (engineering owner + data owner) who will own the sandbox setup?
2) Are you available for a 45-minute technical kickoff this Thursday or next Tuesday so our infra engineer can walk your team through sandbox access and sample ingestion?

Doc/Slides (initial drafts):
- MAP prototype: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A-MapPrototype-Lumina [View/comment]
- Kickoff slides (short): https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1B-KickoffSlides-Lumina

Attachments: [Attachment: MAP-prototype.gdoc (Google Doc)], [Attachment: 30d-eval-checklist.xlsx], [Attachment: kickoff-playbook-slides.v1.pptx]

I'll update the MAP live as we get stakeholder names. If the timeline is aggressive for your team, tell us which milestones you'd like to stretch.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0179

From: Ravi Singh <ravi.singh@luminalabs.com>

Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + 30-day evaluation checklist for Lumina Labs

Thanks Ben — quick read looks sensible. A few notes inline:

- Primary owners: I'll loop in our infra lead (Chris Park) and data PM (Maya R.) — Chris can handle sandbox/network, Maya owns acceptance criteria. I'll introduce them after internal sync.
- Timeline concern: We have a scheduled product freeze next week for a major release; that makes a Thursday kickoff tricky. Could we aim for Tuesday the 18th (US Pacific) for the tech kickoff?
- Sandbox access: we need details on the required IP ranges + whether a temporary S3 bucket is okay for sample data. Also confirm whether Redwood needs any service account whitelisting/keys.

On the MAP details — two asks from our side:
1) Can you add a short section that maps Redwood deliverables to our security/compliance checklist (so our InfoSec can sign off quickly)?
2) For the acceptance criteria, can you include an example test harness and a minimal script that runs the end-to-end latency and quality check?

I'll coordinate internally and aim to prime Chris/Maya for the Tuesday slot.
